new_candidates.body:
### Description

As part of #4178, integration tests using the deprecated `test::Relay` mock system are being refactored to use `Server::EcmScope()`.

In `test/integration/force_torque_system.cc`, the test `MeasureWeightECM` uses `test::Relay` with `OnPreUpdate()` and `OnPostUpdate()` callbacks to:
1. Create `components::WrenchMeasured` on the force torque sensor entity.
2. Read the measured wrench from the ECM after the simulation run.

This setup is an ideal use case for `Server::EcmScope()`. The sensor entity can be queried and have `components::WrenchMeasured` created directly via `EcmScope()` after step 1, and the final measured wrench can be read via `EcmScope()` at the conclusion of the simulation. This completely removes the `test::Relay` mock system and the `Relay.hh` dependency from the test.

### Tasks
- [ ] Refactor `MeasureWeightECM` test in `test/integration/force_torque_system.cc` to use `server.EcmScope()`.
- [ ] Remove `#include "helpers/Relay.hh"`.
new_candidates.title: Refactor force_torque_system integration test to use EcmScope
